arStrings.szText: ...when they returned to Skovos, Philios was surprised to find Hefaetrus working the farms. Philios had fought alongside Hefaetrus during the Purge and knew him to be a skilled artificer.
Formal, an entry in a historical record.

Hefaetrus believed that rebuilding Skovos was done with water, not with blood. Together with his wife, Zerae, he worked and protected what would one day be the fertile fields of the island of Philios...
Formal, an entry in a historical record.
